ai.overview: The BC Lions bring the Belt Holders lineal championship to BC Place as they host the struggling Ottawa Redblacks on October 9th, 2026. BC holds the belt for the first time this reign and will look to notch their first defense against a Redblacks squad that has held the belt 5 times previously but enters winless at 0-15. This marks the first time these two franchises have ever met with the belt on the line.
key_matchups: BC's three-game winning streak against Ottawa's five-game losing skid sets up a stark contrast in form and confidence
The Redblacks' 0-15 record represents their worst season, while BC at 9-6 has playoff positioning to protect alongside belt defense duties
BC won the most recent meeting 45-24 in August, but Ottawa did take a 34-33 thriller last September showing they can compete in this rivalry
ai.betting_angles: BC enters on a three-game winning streak while Ottawa has dropped five straight, including their last meeting where the Lions prevailed 45-24. The Lions hold a 15-7 all-time edge in the series and have won their last three games overall, most recently 24-17 at Toronto. Our Elo model projects BC as a clear favorite, and the form gulf between a 9-6 playoff contender and an 0-15 cellar dweller supports that assessment.
ai.prediction_writeup: The Lions are riding momentum with three consecutive victories and face a Redblacks team that has yet to win a game this season. BC's 45-24 demolition of Ottawa in their August meeting suggests they have the blueprint to exploit this struggling squad. While Ottawa has held the belt 5 times historically, their current 0-15 record and five-game losing streak indicate they lack the tools to pull off what would be a stunning upset. The Lions should successfully defend the belt for the first time in this reign at home.
